_note: Style conventions, not science. Scores are 0-1 (1 = best match). Edit freely; frame names must match products.verified_shape.

oval.why: An oval face is well balanced, so most frame shapes suit it.

round.why: Angular frames add definition and make a round face look longer.

square.why: Round and oval frames soften a strong jaw and angular features.

heart.why: Light, rounded or bottom-heavy frames balance a wider forehead and a narrower chin.

oblong.why: Wide, tall frames add width and make a long face look shorter.
